listing.description: You'll enjoy stunning sunsets from the decks as you unwind at the end of the day. This custom-built home features beautiful oak flooring, vaulted beam ceilings, and 9-foot ceilings throughout the bedrooms. Tall windows and doors open to the newer deck off the living room, perfectly designed to capture the fantastic views while filling the home with natural light. Be sure to check out the oversized downstairs family room, complete with a full bath and potential for an additional bedroom. The spacious laundry area includes an extra 220-volt outlet, ideal for canning, along with a large walk-in pantry for added storage. The detached two-bay garage offers approximately 725 sq. ft. with both power and water. Recent upgrades include a new heat pump, water heater, metal roof on the home, and new composition roofing on the garage.
